subjects.description: A knight in battered plate armour, riding the dragon.
A huge black dragon flying low over the battlefield.
A burning battlefield below the dragon and rider.

speakers.description: The knight in battered plate armour, onscreen.

claims.text: A knight in battered plate armour rides a huge black dragon low over a burning battlefield, cinematic.
The knight is braced in a worn saddle harness with loose straps.
The battlefield has broken ground, embers, ash, drifting smoke, and scattered fires on a wide dark plain.
The knight's visor turns toward the embattled ranks, and flame-light sweeps across the battered plate.
The dragon gives a low rumble and powerful wingbeats while wind rushes past the armour.

soundscape: Heavy wingbeats, roaring flames, wind rushing over armour, creaking harness, a dragon's low rumble, and distant battle clamor.
